issues.description: Concrete animal class names are inconsistent between the problem/template and the solution. The problem statement and template expect concrete classes named Seal, Pig, and Goat (see UML and Main.java commented instantiations). The solution repository implements these animals as SpaceSeal, SpacePig, and SpaceGoat (classes declared in SpaceSeal.java, SpacePig.java, SpaceGoat.java) while the files Seal.java, Pig.java, and Goat.java in the solution are empty placeholders. This naming mismatch prevents students from directly mapping the exercise requirements (Seal/Pig/Goat) to the provided reference implementation and may cause confusion when comparing expected class names with the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make class names consistent across artifacts. Options: (a) Rename the solution classes to the expected names (SpaceSeal -> Seal, SpacePig -> Pig, SpaceGoat -> Goat) and implement or remove the empty placeholder files; or (b) add small wrapper classes named Seal, Pig, Goat in the solution that extend/delegate to the existing Space* classes so the solution contains the exact names used in the problem/template. Update any references accordingly so students can directly map the exercise description to the reference implementation.
